reviews.comment: I needed to replace my ID cooling daisy chain fan and they wont sell you just 1 so I bought these so far I like them but wish they had reverse fans too in 2 or 3 packs. they make reverse fans , ordered  from Amazon Japan. All 10 fans are Redragon, I am trying to control them with signal rgb . I like them when set as a LED strip. they have 24 LEDs per fan I am told and I like the halo and rgb and mirror combo. the video will cycle through 6ish 20 second effect play list. 1 fan is acting up after barely 3months they took care of me I am making a white build and ordered 3 3packs of fans from redragon the reverse fans came with 2 cables which was great because I had trouble getting 1 cable to work but finally did but I see my 1 pack of forward fans bought here and 1 from redragon only have 1 cable in each box so I am dropping my 5 star review to 4 for not having the extra cables. that being said I think these are the best looking fans out there and with the right controller you can make the colors go across the daisy chain by assigning them as a LED strip or the 3 fans all change color the same assigned as individual fans. will have white fan photos after I build. more....

reviews.title: Great RGB Fans
reviews.comment: These are really great RGB fans for the price. They play well with my motherboard's RGB software (ASRock Polychrome) and respond well to the fan curve I programmed in the BIOS. RGBs are bright and colors are very distinct. I used one set of these as case fans and the other set to replace the fans on my AIO cooler so they would match. All hardware that comes with it is good quality and should fit most cases or radiators. The snap-together daisy-chain system makes them incredibly easy to install and reduces the number of wires you need to run. The infinity design on them is on both the center of the fan and the sides, along with the Redragon logo and brand name, but it doesn't look tacky at all. Personally I love it. As far as noise goes, they're quiet when not under load but can get noticeably noisy if you have a sharp curve set. I am personally not bothered by the noise so I can't comment on if it would bother someone or not, I prefer my computer to sound like a jet engine when I'm stress testing it. These will be my new go-to case fans for building since they're much cheaper than Lian Li and work just as well.
reviews.author: Amanda
